Standard: The light intensities of forward and rear position lights, with covers and color filters installed (if equipped), is expressed in terms of minimum intensities in the horizontal plane and minimum intensities in any vertical plane within dihedral angles L, R, and A, and meets the following requirements: a. Intensities in the horizontal plane: Each intensity in the horizontal plane (the plane containing the longitudinal axis of the air vehicle and perpendicular to the plane of symmetry of the air vehicle) is equal to or exceed the values in TABLE VIII. TABLE VIII. Horizontal plane intensities. Dihedral angle (light included) Angle from right or left of longitudinal axis, measured from dead ahead Intensity (candles) L and R (forward red and green) 0 to 10 degrees 10 to 20 degrees 20 to 110 degrees 40 30 5 A (rear white) 110 to 180 degrees 20 b. Intensities in any vertical plane: Each intensity in any vertical plane (the plane perpendicular to the horizontal plane) is equal to or exceeds the appropriate value in TABLE IX, where I is the minimum intensity prescribed for the corresponding angles in the horizontal plane. TABLE IX. Vertical plane intensities. Angle above or below the horizontal plane Intensity, I 0 degrees 1.00 0 to 5 degrees 0.90 5 to 10 degrees 0.80 10 to 15 degrees 0.70 15 to 20 degrees 0.50 20 to 30 degrees 0.30 30 to 40 degrees 0.10 40 to 90 degrees 0.05 Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Intensities will be measured at various angles IAW TABLE VIII and TABLE IX.
